:::{#thm-bernoulli-score}
#### Score function of a Bernoulli variable

Let $X \sim \Ber(\prob)$.
The score of a single observation $x$ is its deviation from the mean,
divided by the variance:

$$\score = \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}} = \frac{x - \prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-derive-bernoulli-score.

:::
